  REGULAR MEETING OF THE

  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 24, 2024 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Planning
Commission with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 4th Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City at Planning@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at (626) 300­0713
prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to participate in the meeting from home:
Visit www.CityofSanMarino.org/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:
How to offer public comment from home: Public comment will be accepted by email to
Planning@CityofSanMarino.org until 3:00 p.m. the day of the meeting. Written public
comment received by 3:00 p.m. will be distributed to the Design Review Committee during the
meeting. Any comments received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment
record but not provided to the Design Review Committee at the meeting. Written public
comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module during the

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Alternate Ching Chiao, Alternate James Okazaki, Commissioner Howard Brody,
Commissioner John Dustin, Commissioner Jeri Wright, Vice Chair Shelley Boyle, and

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Planning Commission
by submitting a public comment request and giving it to the Community Development Director
prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the Planning Commission on items
that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the Planning Commission may not discuss
or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.3).
 The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to
follow up on such items.

2.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR THE MODIFICATION OF
  DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR 21­26 AT 1733 EUSTON ROAD TO
  REVISE THE APPROVED LANDSCAPE PLAN. (CHANG)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the Planning Commission: 1. Determine that based on the whole of
  the administrative record, the proposed project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 3 (New Construction or Conversion of
  Small Structures), and that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an
  exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2
  applies; 2. Find that the proposed project meets the required findings; and 3.
  Approve the project.

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Planning Commission make the determination
  as to whether the story poles should be modified and reinstalled for the revised
  design changes.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve the
  minutes of the special meeting of December 4, 2023.
